ns2:section.sectionText: Over the past 5 years, scientists have become increasingly interested in the psychology of magic and the parallels between magic and the study of visual perception and attention. This seminar will review this new literature and will explore the parallels between the science of visual perception and attention and the techniques used by magicians. Readings will include books and articles on the theory of magic, discussions of magic in the scientific literature, and writings by magicians about the psychological underpinnings of their techniques. As part of the course, we will attempt to develop experiments that test the intuitions that magicians have about the psychological underpinnings of their methods.
